answer_1.quote: In this work, we study a new generation paradigm for LLMs ... to provide citations to one or a few text passages for any statement they generate (Figure).
answer_1.outputs: Long-form answers that include citations to supporting passages

answer_2.quote: We design automatic evaluation methods in three dimensions: fluency, correctness, and citation quality. Specifically, we use MAUVE to measure fluency, propose tailored correctness metrics for each dataset, and adopt a natural language inference (NLI) model to measure citation quality.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluation on selected models and request workers to judge model generations on three dimensions similar to Liu et al. (1) utility: a 1-to-5 score ... (2) citation recall ... (3) citation precision ...
answer_4.guideline: Workers rate utility on a Likert scale and assess citation recall and citation precision for each statement and its citations.
